notes.title: The actual last patch before Remake
notes.content:
Fixed thing :
Crash at game end screen should have been fixed now

notes.title: The very very last patch for sure before Grand Remake next year
notes.content:
Fixed thing :
If an enemy fall and die from the fall damage, they'll never reappear.

notes.title: Small Patch before I REMAKE IT ENTIRELY.
notes.content:
Fixed Bug :
When an enemy falls down off cliff or water, then drops their HP down to zero, they'll become invincible throughout the stage. (The bug only increased difficulty and didn't make it impossible to play, proven by someone ></ )

notes.title: Update on March 6th, 2021, only a little bit of fix.
notes.content:
Fix for an error :
If somehow last boss was defeated while there are still projectiles killing the player resulting in player's death, the ending will not be properly shown and gets crashed.

notes.title: 1.0.12 - Emergency error fix
notes.content:
SORRY!
Fix to a new error that affected the main game I didn't notice 'cause I added DLC things in the program.

notes.title: 1.0.11 - Fix to a rare error and a peek to One True World DLC for who owns it.
notes.content:
Fix to a rare error that can be encountered at 4th boss, by falling just-right before shadow spikes generated.

The peeking for the DLC is available for Ethel and everyone else who already owns the DLC, which must go through me personally via Steam key.
But it's still very very early to be playable.

notes.title: 1.0.10 - Fatal Error Fixes, and balance change to ice special
notes.content:
FIXED ALL THESE FATAL ERRORS :

- Restarting on boss stage when falling generated error
- Clearing stage might generate some errors 'cause it was somehow badly-programmed. My bad.

And also, change to the ice special, Cold Air : the duration is increased by 1.5 seconds.

notes.title: Restart Bug Fix & New DLC List Screen
notes.content:
Fixed a problem where the player character will vanish when restarting right after falling.

And new DLC List Screen that's more obvious and with better animation.

notes.title: Bug Fix = Other Bug, but it's okay now
notes.content:
Because of an update from 3 days ago, bug fix made some other bug instead, but it has been really fixed now.
That bug affects Stage 5 things, so if there is anyone who faced this problem, I'm really sorry!

notes.title: The forgotten feature: RESTART ... and other fixes
notes.content:
Some people has been asking for RESTART button to quickly restart a stage, so this is it~ x3

And I have also fixed a bug occuring in a certain late-game puzzle stage with a lot of ice cubes in it.

notes.title: Some More Small Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed some problem where a stage in Easy mode has invisible floors (I forgot to make it visible since I added extra floors in Easy mode)

And fixed to properly show the button for Gamepad in tutorial instead of [?].

notes.title: UPDATE 0.9 - More contents!!!
notes.content:
Version 0.9's update log :

[b]NEW CONTENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]ACHIEVEMENTS - Challenge your skill to achieve these pretty hard-to-clear achievements!
[*]FIRST ENDING - Which will make you wonder... "How about the other ending(s)?"
[*]NEW BGMs, by Eric Matyas (soundimage.org)
[*]A bit more texts to read
[*]2 more stages to play.
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed controller settings and added a quick gene-swap feature like Me**man game's L/R weapon-swap feature.
[*]Transforming to another gene doesn't require maximum HP anymore. It sucked. :)
[*]Shadow tentacle-like boss's sweeping attack has less height hitbox so that players can jump over it easier. (I didn't intend to make it so hard for mid-game boss.) xD
[*]Small changes on some stages.
[*]Fixed Japanese texts.
[/list]
